script.es: Tu perro, feliz y bien cuidado.
script.en: Your dog, happy and well cared for.

parrafo.es: En la casita azul de la 4th Ave N, Mary y Kelley banan, cortan y arreglan perros de todo pelaje desde el 2011. Sus clientes en Google cuentan como su perro sale feliz y luciendo precioso, visita tras visita.
parrafo.en: In the little blue cottage on 4th Ave N, Mary and Kelley have been bathing, cutting and styling dogs of every coat since 2011. Their Google reviewers describe a dog that comes out happy and looking adorable, visit after visit.

hero.imagen_alt: Perro bichon recien banado y arreglado con un panuelo a cuadros rojos en Harbor Pets Grooming

parrafo_1.es: Harbor Pets Grooming abrio sus puertas en el 2011 en una casita azul del centro de Safety Harbor. Mary y Kelley atienden ahi mismo, banando, cortando y cuidando perros de todos los tamanos y pelajes.
parrafo_1.en: Harbor Pets Grooming opened in 2011 in a little blue cottage in downtown Safety Harbor. Mary and Kelley work out of that same shop, bathing, cutting and caring for dogs of every size and coat.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google cuentan que se nota su amor por los animales desde que uno cruza la puerta, y que perros con pelo grueso y dificil salen luciendo igual de bien que los de pelaje facil. Una clienta los visito durante 16 anos con su mismo perro.
parrafo_2.en: Their Google reviewers say you can tell they love animals the moment you walk through the door, and that dogs with thick, difficult coats come out looking just as good as the easy ones. One customer brought the same dog here for 16 years.

eyebrow.es: La visita de tu perro, paso a paso
eyebrow.en: Your dog's visit, step by step

texto.es: Nos cuentas de tu perro y coordinamos su cita.
texto.en: Tell us about your dog and we will set up a visit.

texto.es: Bano a fondo segun su pelaje y piel, con calma y paciencia.
texto.en: A thorough bath suited to their coat and skin, done calmly and patiently.

texto.es: Mary y Kelley cortan y peinan a mano, hasta en pelajes dificiles.
texto.en: Mary and Kelley hand-cut and style, even on difficult, thick coats.

texto.es: Unas y oidos, panuelo, y tu perro listo para salir feliz.
texto.en: Nails, ears, a little bandana, and your dog ready to leave happy.

nota.es: El precio depende del tamano y tipo de pelaje de tu perro. Llamanos y te damos el detalle.
nota.en: Pricing depends on your dog's size and coat type. Call us and we will walk you through it.

texto.es: Bano, secado y cepillado a fondo para perros de cualquier tamano.
texto.en: Bath, blow-dry and thorough brush-out for dogs of any size.

texto.es: Cortes a mano incluso en pelajes gruesos y dificiles, como el de un doodle lanudo.
texto.en: Hand-scissored cuts even on thick, difficult coats, like a wooly doodle.

texto.es: Corte de unas y limpieza de oidos, con calma para perros nerviosos.
texto.en: Nail trims and ear cleaning, done with patience for anxious dogs.

texto.es: Cepillado profundo para pelajes densos que sueltan mucho pelo.
texto.en: Deep brush-out for heavy-shedding, dense coats.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Llamanos igual, lo cotizamos.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Call us anyway and we will quote it.

subtitulo.es: Resenas reales de clientes en Google.

items.quote: This was my first visit to see Mary and Kelley. They did a wonderful grooming job with Buddy. You can tell that they love animals as soon as you walk through the door. Highly recommend their services.

We took our Shih Tzu Oreo for 16 years to Harbor Pets, they were always so good to him and he always came back looking so cute! Now we have a new Aussie doodle named Lucy and they do an amazing job with her, she has really thick wooly hair.
They do a fantastic job on our mini Poodle! Absolutely the nicest and most caring groomers and our little guy loves to go to his spa.

texto.es: Llamanos para agendar la cita de tu perro.
texto.en: Call us to book your dog's appointment.

texto.es: Abierto de lunes a sabado, 8 AM a 5 PM. Cerrado los domingos.
texto.en: Open Monday through Saturday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Closed Sundays.
